_provenance: Sanitized sleep-shape matrix (run 2026-09-17-normalizer-audit). Shapes mirror tests/acceptance/parse_everything.py and tests/unit/test_normalize.py (census-locked subsets of the audited corpora; research/predecessor-inventory.md section 7). Source names generic ('Apple Watch', 'AutoSleep', 'watch'); values kept only where the rule's precedence depends on them.
census_note: census_weight is per lane: how many real corpus rows this single shape stands for. Audited decomposition (research section 7): recent 130 exports = 120 Watch sentinel nights + 8 AutoSleep naps + 2 in-bed-only = 130 sleep points -> 128 sleep_analysis rows kept + 2 in-bed-only split; backfill = 1,150 Watch sentinel nights + 50 mixed-stage nights + 1,000 AutoSleep rows + 300 in-bed-untracked rows = 2,500 sleep points -> 2,200 kept + 300 in-bed-only splits. The census-lock test (tests/unit/test_census_lock.py) asserts sum(weight x outcome) equals those numbers for both lanes; the 'in-bed split' census counts points whose only row is sleep_in_bed (co-emitted in-bed rows on nap/stage shapes are locked per-shape, not in the split census).

fixtures.desc: Scenario 1: REST Watch night with asleep:0 sentinel; totalSleep wins (1,150 backfill nights + 120 recent nights)
Scenario 2: Watch mixed-stage night where asleep is a REAL 4th stage; totalSleep = core+deep+rem+asleep exactly (50/50 verified)
Scenario 3: AutoSleep row, asleep-only value; the fixture nap carries inBed == asleep (real AutoSleep shape) so the in-bed split co-emits BOTH rows
Scenario 4: pre-Watch era in-bed-untracked row (all sleep fields 0, inBed>0); emits only sleep_in_bed, zero sleep_analysis rows
Scenario 9: {date, asleep, core, deep, rem} without totalSleep; loosened recognition keeps it (asleep wins), not a drop
